focus: Compare host-side connect behavior between the live qga socket and a temporary unix socket backend created in the same libvirt channel directory.
findings: A temporary QMP chardev socket created at /run/user/1000/libvirt/qemu/run/channel/1-regprobe-win11-25h2-/codex.same-dir.sock accepted a direct host-side AF_UNIX connection successfully.

The live qga socket at /run/user/1000/libvirt/qemu/run/channel/1-regprobe-win11-25h2-/org.qemu.guest_agent.0 still returned ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused') on the same direct host-side connect pattern.
That means the libvirt qemu run/channel directory itself is not the source of the persistent refusal.
The remaining failure is specific to the live qga channel state or qga integration path, not to the host path prefix or directory placement.
